# Objective

Add per-reference strand counts to `qc-summary`: `forward_reads`,
`reverse_reads`, and `forward_pct` columns in the existing one-row-per-reference
Parquet digest. Counts read the FLAG 0x10 bit (`record.is_reverse`) during the
existing single pass; no new CLI flag.

# Scope

Decisions confirmed with the user on 2026-10-20:

1. Placement: qc-summary columns (not an annotate `--strand-stats` file).
2. Keep all four annotate stats flags; keep every existing qc-summary column
   (keep-both direction).
3. No configurable output columns — consumers project Parquet columns at read
   time.
4. Counting semantics: mapped records only (unmapped skipped by the loop
   already); secondary (0x100) and supplementary (0x800) alignments included,
   so `forward_reads + reverse_reads == total_reads` in every row.
5. `forward_pct = forward_reads / total_reads` (0.0 when total is 0), mirroring
   `fl_pct`.

# Planned steps (as-built: executed exactly as planned, 2026-10-20)

1. Tests first (`tests/test_qc_summary.py`): `test_qc_summary_strand_columns`
   (FLAG 0/16, secondary 0x100, supplementary 0x800|16, unmapped excluded,
   identity, zero-read refs) and `test_qc_summary_strand_all_reverse`. RED
   confirmed: `KeyError: 'forward_reads'`.
2. `src/sam_tagger/stats/qc_summary.py`: `forward`/`reverse` on `_QcCounts`,
   `tally_strand(ref, is_reverse)`, three `_SCHEMA` entries after
   `total_reads`, appends in `write_results` with a zero-total guard.
3. `src/sam_tagger/lib.py`: `qc.tally_strand(ref_name, record.is_reverse)`
   beside `qc.tally_total(ref_name)` in `run_qc_summary`.
4. `docs/usage.qmd`: 18-column list, no-config note, and the counting
   semantics (mapped-only, secondary/supplementary included, row identity).
5. Verify: 135 tests passed, ruff clean, pyright clean; end-to-end 200k-read
   run showed zero `forward + reverse != total_reads` violations.
6. Commit `63f8a48` `feat: add forward/reverse strand read columns to
   qc-summary`; report at
   [20261020-210931](20261020-210931_add-qc-summary-strand-cols.report.qmd).

# Files to touch

- `src/sam_tagger/stats/qc_summary.py` — counts, schema, tally, write.
- `src/sam_tagger/lib.py` — one tally call in the qc-summary loop.
- `tests/test_qc_summary.py` — new test(s).
- `docs/usage.qmd` — column list + no-config wording.

# Risks

- Additive schema change for downstream consumers — same shape as the v0.3.0
  `to_*` precedent (additive columns; consumers selecting by name are safe).
- None for performance: measured ~25 ns/read for the strand branch (5 ms per
  200k reads).

# Verification criteria

1. New tests pass; full suite green.
2. `forward_reads + reverse_reads == total_reads` holds on mixed-flag BAMs,
   including secondary/supplementary records.
3. Zero-read refs emit 0/0/0.0 without division errors.
4. No-config runs populate the strand columns.
